data.text:
Three were hurt while 10 families were affected in a fire that hit a commercial and residential area along UN Avenue in Paco, Manila on early Monday morning.

The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) said the fire was placed under control by 2:18 AM and was eventually put out at around 2:48 AM. 

Video courtesy: Monica Tutor via Bea Pinlac/GMA Integrated News
